Extracts the cross sections of a river from an elevation model, along the line of the river: the input of the 1D hydraulic models, as SaintGeo and HEC-RAS.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Sections, Raster, Vector, Hydraulic<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RiverSectionsExtractor`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model. |
| `inRiver` | vector file |  |  | The line of the river, drawn from upstream along the bottom of its channel. |
| `inRiverPoints` | vector file |  |  | Optional points of the river where to place the sections, instead of at the interval. |
| `inBridges` | vector file |  |  | Optional points of the bridges, with a section on each and just upstream and downstream of it. |
| `inSections` | vector file |  |  | Optional sections created before by this module, to use instead of extracting them at the interval. |
| `pSectionsIntervalDistance` | double | m | `10.0` | The distance between the sections, along the river. |
| `pSectionsWidth` | double | m | `10.0` | The distance of the section ends from the river line, on each side: the section is twice as wide. |
| `pBridgeBuffer` | double | m | `0` | The distance within which a bridge point is considered on the river. |
| `fBridgeWidth` | String |  |  | The field of the width of the bridges. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSections` | output file |  | The section lines. |
| `outSectionPoints` | output file |  | The points of the sections, with their elevation. |
| `outRiverPoints` | output file |  | The points of the river between the sections, with their elevation. |
